name: EndoTrack Quantum Triage Agent
description: Women's-health quantum biomarker triage agent (endometriosis risk stratification on Quantinuum Guppy + Selene). Exposes certified quantum evidence — Fourier-wall QML advantage (0.640 vs 0.513 AUC on the order-3 interacting label), 16/16 cell QAOA verification, Guppy Playpond demo links, the Top-4 roadmap, and the RRI model card — to other agents via the EndoTrack MCP server. Evidence discipline: every number comes from committed, seed-tagged result JSON in the nhsquantinuum repository; no invented values; all data synthetic or public-aggregate, Nexus T&C compliant. Not clinical guidance.

skills.name: Certified quantum evidence
skills.description: Query EndoTrack's certified performance: quantum-vs-classical AUC per cell (order-3 interacting / order-1 product / ablations), 16-cell referral-QUBO sweep verdicts, and artifact verification. Delegates to the MCP tools get_certified_results, get_triage_rows, verify_artifact.
examples: What is the certified AUC of the quantum kernel on the order-3 interacting label?
Which classical baseline does the quantum kernel beat?
Verify that endo_substrate_certified.json is a committed, parseable artifact.

skills.name: Guppy Playpond live demos
skills.description: Return verified one-click Guppy Playpond share links (Bell sanity, biomarker tilt, MCMR ancilla reuse, EndoTrack referral QUBO, Fourier probe) that run in the browser with seed + shot controls. Delegates to the MCP tool get_playpond_links.
examples: Give me the Playpond demo links.

skills.name: Roadmap & RRI model card
skills.description: Introduce the Top-4 roadmap phases (hardware-indexed Helios→Lumos grid, 8 phases to the 15 Oct 2026 submission) and the RRI transparency model card (Everitt & Ji arXiv:2412.13151). Delegates to the MCP tools get_roadmap_status and get_model_card.
examples: What phase is the project in?
